parts.text: Some students determine the focal length of a converging lens by different methods. Method 1 One student uses the apparatus shown in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student sets the distance between the illuminated triangle and the mirror to 40 cm. He moves the lens until he sees a sharp image of the triangle on the card, by the side of the illuminated triangle.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Fig. 3.1, measure the distance f 1 between the illuminated triangle and the lens. f 1 = ............................................................... Fig. 3.1 is drawn to 1/5 th scale. Calculate the actual distance F 1 between the illuminated triangle and the lens in this experiment. This is a value for the focal length of the lens. F 1 = ............................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(a)(ii)
ms.text: move lens backwards and forwards slowly OR move lens slowly

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student sets the distance between the illuminated triangle and the lens to U = 20.0 cm. She moves the screen until a sharp image of the triangle appears on the screen.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure h O , the height of the illuminated triangle as shown in Fig. 3.3. h O = ............................................................... Measure h I , the height of the image on the screen as shown in Fig. 3.4. h I = ............................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(b)(ii)
ms.text:
hand gets in way of light
mark on screen and measure later OR
use screen with scale OR
use translucent screen and measure at rear

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate a value W using the equation W = h O h I . W = ............................................................... Calculate a second value F 2 for the focal length of the lens, using the equation F 2 = U ( W + 1) . F 2 = ............................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(b)(iii)
ms.text:
F2 = 16.1 or 16.2 (cm)
F2 expressed to 2 or 3 significant figures with matching unit

ms.label: 3(c)
ms.text:
statement matching results
values within limits of experimental accuracy/owtte
and values quoted in justification

ms.label: 3(d)
ms.text:
any one from:
mark position of lens on holder
clamp/place rule on bench
ensure screen, lens and object all perpendicular
view rule perpendicularly
repeat and take average
use darkened room/brighter light
